item.description:
v0.2.8: Link a Claude account with Google or email
- Continue with Google on the claude.ai sign-in now works: its popup opens over the page in the same window and hands the sign-in back when it closes. - Signing in with email no longer leaves you on claude.ai's own app inside the window without linking the account. - The window that asks which organisation to link, or says a link failed, is sized to what it says rather than drawn as tall as the screen.

v0.2.7: Spend a Codex reset from Sissy
- The Codex page now shows the resets your account holds and when the next one expires. Once OpenAI would apply one, when a window is nearly used up, a Use… button spends it for the account the page is showing. - Sissy asks before spending, and trying again after an answer that never arrived cannot spend a second reset.

v0.2.6: Update checks you can watch
- Check for Updates in About now checks in place: a spinner, then the answer under the button (up to date, a new version, or a check that could not reach the feed), with no window in the way. A new version turns the button into Update to it, which opens the usual update alert. - The notice about a Claude Code sign-in Sissy does not read is now a short, clearly marked warning, and it no longer appears for a folder you stopped using weeks ago.

v0.2.5: Sissy updates itself
- Sissy checks for new versions on its own and installs one only when you say so. The controls sit at the foot of About: the current version, a Check for Updates button, and a switch for automatic checks. - Updates are signed and notarized, and Sissy verifies each one before installing it. - This is the last version you install by hand: 0.2.4 cannot update itself, so download 0.2.5 once and later versions arrive through Sissy. - About's links stay blue and the sheet ends on the copyright line.
